description: This file defines the Maintenance controller class for the startup process in the OpenCart system. It checks whether the site is in maintenance mode and, if so, redirects non-logged-in users away from the site except for certain ignored routes.

classes.name: Maintenance
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling site maintenance mode checks and redirection.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that checks if maintenance mode is active and redirects non-logged-in users accordingly.
